SQL:
WITH __slayer_stage_rc AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."returns.customer_id" AS "customer_id",
    _stage_inner."returns._count" AS "_count"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      returns.customer_id AS "returns.customer_id",
      COUNT(*) AS "returns._count"
    FROM returns AS returns
    GROUP BY
      returns.customer_id
  ) AS _stage_inner
)
SELECT
  customers.tier AS "customers.tier",
  COUNT(*) AS "customers._count"
FROM customers AS customers
LEFT JOIN __slayer_stage_rc AS rc
  ON customers.id = rc.customer_id
WHERE
  rc.customer_id IS NULL
GROUP BY
  customers.tier
LIMIT 21
